contributor to MP (1868)

He published Essays and Stories by the late G. W. Bosanquet (1870). CMY’s letter about his contribution is in a collection formed by Elizabeth Bosanquet. He was staying with the children\'s writer W. H. G. Kingston at the time of the 1861 census.
